name: annotation mapping observes RHS first
codes:
from __future__ import annotations
class D(dict):
    def __setitem__(self,k,v):
        print("annotation",k)
        super().__setitem__(k,v)
__annotations__=D()
def rhs(v):
    print("value",v)
    return v+1
x:int=(rhs(x))
print(x)
